notes.title: Beyond Enemy Lines – Vietnam: Technical Playtest Begins Now!
notes.content:
We're kicking off our technical playtest today, May 23 – a bit differently than planned.

[previewyoutube=OeL0vvx32zQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Due to a pending approval for the dedicated Playtest App, we've decided to launch the Steam Demo version early instead. This version will be updated continuously based on your feedback and will remain available for about one month, including during Steam Next Fest.

[b]What's in the demo?[/b]
You'll experience a slice of a campaign mission with multiple replayable routes. Each run takes between 30 and 60 minutes. Weapons can be ranked up, and attachments unlocked.

[b]What we're looking for:[/b]
[list]
[*] How well does it run on your system?
[*] Did you encounter any critical bugs or crashes?
[*] Are there design elements you’d like to see improved?
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/4b37ec36792022fa2d73018e6eaae9840337a769.jpg[/img]

⚠️ [b]This is a work-in-progress. Expect bugs, placeholder content, and unfinished systems. Your input will directly shape how the game evolves.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/09c9c962a47625315bd933e566b6c10ee0809d63.jpg[/img]

🐛 [b]Known & Expected Bugs[/b]
As this is an early work-in-progress build, some issues are known and currently being addressed:

[list]
[*] [b]Unresponsive AI Behavior[/b]
Enemy AI may occasionally fail to react properly. This is often caused by missing information nodes or the inability to find valid cover. We're actively adjusting these systems to strike the right balance between performance and intelligent behavior.

[*] [b]Weapon Rank Display Bug[/b]
In some cases, the in-game weapon rank may appear to reset or decrease after restarting a mission. This is purely a visual issue — your actual progress and weapon stats remain unaffected.

[*] [b]Audio Mixing Incomplete[/b]
The overall sound mix is still under development. Expect placeholder audio, inconsistent volume levels, and general imbalance. This is a key area we’ll be improving over the coming weeks.

[*] [b]Gameplay Lag Spikes[/b]
You may experience minor stutters or lag spikes, particularly when loading new sections of the level. We’re aware of this and working on smoother level streaming and performance optimizations.
[/list]

Please continue to share your experiences — your feedback is critical as we refine the game.

📥 [b]Download the demo now from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467270/Beyond_Enemy_Lines__Vietnam/]Steam Store page[/url].[/b]

[b]Wishlist Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam on Steam now: [/b]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467270/Beyond_Enemy_Lines__Vietnam/

notes.title: The future of United Assault, Beyond Enemy Lines and survey evaluation
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today is the day we look into the future of United Assault, Beyond Enemy Lines and evaluate the latest 'Next Game' survey. There is a lot of new stuff coming in 2022 to play. Lets get started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/cba9debad65ec4df9b051aa8fc02b778a66f5dd1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/c5101b517df9d38ab2768fdeb42f05a1d48b1c11.png[/img]

United Assault - Normandy'44 is a massive success for Polygon Art and the quickest selling game we ever build! I have big planes for United assault and here is what's coming next:

I'm very Happy to announce:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/2f3fc03bb5404f14332e455c98b4db2c0d5a595a.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625340/United_Assault__Battle_of_the_Bulge/

[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/2e1034806bc63a5d27dcdf98b543c419a5f681d5.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/2e1034806bc63a5d27dcdf98b543c419a5f681d5.png[/img][/url]
[i]Click for full screen view[/i]

[b]United Assault - Battle of the Bulge is a standalone expansion to United Assault - Normandy'44 and an open world rogue lite FPS set in 1944's depiction of Ardennes.[/b]

As a british paratromy you are assigned to a mission, few would qualify for. You are tasked to infiltrate enemy territory and locate, infiltrate and destroy one of germany's secret V2 factories in the Ardennes. You'll come along heavy enemy resistance, try to weaken their defense by destroying their tanks, equipment and by gathering secret documents.

[previewyoutube=S_a8nc8H4cY;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625340/United_Assault__Battle_of_the_Bulge/][b]ADD UNITED ASSAULT - BATTLE OF THE BULGE TO YOUR WISHLIST![/b][/url]

[h2][b]What is new?[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Playing as a british paratrooper and deploying on a parachute into the game.
[*] Authentic british World War 2 weapons
[*] Larger and more detailed towns and cities
[*] Drivable vehicles scattered around the gameworld
[*] The story is now directly integrated into the main gamemode
[*] Procedural generated underground bunkers complexes (like dungeons)
[/list]
[h2][b]What does this mean for United Assault - Normandy'44?[/b][/h2]
More updates, features and improvements! I'm not going to abandon United Assault - Normandy'44!
Both games are build with the same code base and allows me to patch new features and improvements from Battle of the Bulge back into Normandy '44. All gameplay, gunplay and AI improvements will find it's way into Normandy'44 as well as several new weapons! If you don't want Battle of the Bulge, you still benefit from its development and get regular news updates.

[h2][b]Looking even more into the future?[/b][/h2]
I plann to expand United Assault with 2 additional standalone expansions in the same form as Battle of the Bulge. Those are:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/ae32e4afe7704d986384170c41ebe27b778eea33.png[/img]

[h3][b]United Assault Social Media[/b][/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/MZkDwCRb2b]Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/UnitedAssaultGame]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/PolygonArt]Twitter[/url]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/cba9debad65ec4df9b051aa8fc02b778a66f5dd1.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/15b7e0fa8f8d38a78129449176be71e2e8553061.png[/img]

Beyond Enemy Lines is returning in 2022 with a major update to Beyond Enemy Lines 2 and an entirly new game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/584c45f38fd991d528811c488f36cc7c9fe7d853.png[/img]

[b]Beyond Enemy Lines 2 is getting a free update to a Enhanced Edition![/b]

This update will bring new content, improved game- and gunplay, enhanced visuals and major performance improvements. The before canceled DLC Beyond Enemy Lines 2 - Origins will be added for free to the game.

[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/a4ddd5b37e76e9f9e94ee85fe87e58beacd3412c.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40088640/a4ddd5b37e76e9f9e94ee85fe87e58beacd3412c.png[/img][/url]
[i]Click for full screen view[/i]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] A new, fully voiced 8 mission long campaign of the reimagined Beyond Enemy Lines 1 Story
[*] All other DLC contents will be free for all owners of the base game
[*] The price will increase from 24.99€ to 29.99€ to get in line with the Console versions
[*] Improved update pipeline for faster updates in the future
[*] Contails all map and mission improvements of the console version
[/list]

The Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Enhanced Edition will be released early 2022 for free to all owners of the game on PC and Xbox One with additional native Xbox Series S|X support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/6966d5659cc0311781b25c7c344be9a592db23cf.png[/img]

[b]Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is the newest entry in the Beyond Enemy Lines franchise hitting Steam Early Access in Summer 2022![/b]

Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is a modern warfare shooter set in the Quang-Xiong Island, an autonomous island in the east chinese sea.
The island is of great military importance and the source of numerous conflicts. Whoever hasmilitary control over this territory, is in close range to attack china, taiwan, japan, as well as south and north korea.

Satellite intel reports a lot of recent activity on this island and satellite fotos indicate chinese forces occupied the island. China denies this information and confirms that it has not sent any troops to the region. We cannot verify the credibility of the statement, nor can we verify the identity of the occupiers.

We need to get to the bottom of this mess. You need to be careful - we don’t want a major international incident out of this.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Powered by Unreal Engine 5 with Lumen Global Illumination and Reflections
[*] Command your own Squad
[*] Modern arsenal of highly detailed weapons
[*] Large, complex missions with full tactical freedom
[*] Mid mission checkpoints
[/list]
Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is smaller game in scope then Beyond Enemy Lines 2. We target a story set on 3-4 Missions, each lasting for ~60 minutes. We want to test out new stuff with this game, like a own AI controlled squad you can gve orders to and dip our toe into releasing a game with a new Engine - Unreal Engine 5. Beyond Enemy Lines - Rising Dragon is building the foundation for Beyond Enemy Lines 3 ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/cba9debad65ec4df9b051aa8fc02b778a66f5dd1.png[/img]



[h1]The Next Game Survey[/h1]
I asked on Social Media, Steam and other platforms what you want to see in the future. Here is the evaluation of this survey with 983 participants at the time of evaluation.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/372f6b1145d749d7be1ff85a1944249cf9d2f850.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/a55a14097947f434cbdb08bf9519e1938dcf885a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/2447647b3d1695dd93b9b7374666fb07b3b84133.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/3b9c88bc125a152404dd5c824fb9b1d5f9020c6b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/f295b4800ec5564fb6cfe3b549f555971849e439.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/73241b9e800edc4dcc436a2e0d78879e236e4bea.png[/img][/url]
[i]Click for full screen view[/i]

The majority of you ([b]60%[/b]) want to see a new [b]Singleplayer[/b] game developed. The diversity in genres you want to see us develop was a majot supprise. [b]FPS[/b] games are by far ([b]35%[/b]) the most requested games, as we develop mostly FPS games this is no big surprise. Followed by this are Simulation (14%) and Role Playing (13%) and Third Person Shooter and Action Adventire (12%).

Beyond Enemy Lines - The Role Playing experience? How would this sound to you? We will continue to focus on FPS games but will definitly consider developing smaller games in the other genres in the future.

We also asked which game you would like to see next. [b]35%[/b] of you want to see a [b]new franchise[/b], 28% a new Beyond Enemy Lines and as United Assault is still a very fresh game it already gathered a respectful 23%.  As both Beyond Enemy Lines and United Assault got new content and games revealed in this news, let's jump to the new franchise ...

[b]The new franchise[/b]

We asked for suggestions which game you would like to see. And apparently you have a very clear goal in mind for us. You want to see from us in the future:

A Singleplayer FPS with focus on Story, more linear gameplay with occasionally larger areas with more freedom. The games you mentioned where shocklingly simmilar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40088640/a9576a3afae61bffbde29c63d3713909bed5b128.png[/img]
You frequently Menitioned Golden Eye and other 007 games as well as No One Lives Forever.

We will follow your wishes and start concepting a new James Bond/No One Lives Forever like franchise together with you in 2022. More on this will follow next year!
